why: The black dot moves a quarter turn clockwise inside the circle each step: top, right, bottom, left. Next it comes back to the top, which is option 1. Option 3 stays on the left and option 4 is at the bottom-right.
trick: Top, right, bottom, left: a quarter turn each time brings the dot back to the start after 4 steps.
